ThingDef.label: SimpleSandbags
ThingDef.description: These are simple sandbag walls piled randomly. They are more fragile than those built over a little more time, but at least they provide cover.

ThingDef.label: ZE-GUN
ThingDef.description: Sentry guns are deployed by EDF in large numbers. Can be operated for long periods of time due to its internal power source. It automatically supplements and attacks the enemy.

ThingDef.label: ZE-GUN
ThingDef.description: Minigun turret with automatic sighting device.

ThingDef.label: ZE-Sniper
ThingDef.description: Sentry guns are deployed by EDF in large numbers. Can be operated for long periods of time due to its internal power source. It automatically supplements and attacks the enemy. It is a sniper type with a long range.

ThingDef.label: ZE-Sniper
ThingDef.description: Sniper turret with automatic sighting device.

ThingDef.label: ZE-Launcher
ThingDef.description: Sentry guns are deployed by EDF in large numbers. Can be operated for long periods of time due to its internal power source. It automatically supplements and attacks the enemy. It is a Rocket Launcher type.

ThingDef.label: ZE-Launcher
ThingDef.description: Rocket Launcher turret with automatic sighting device.

ThingDef.label: EDF-E2HMG
ThingDef.description: It is a heavy machine gun operated by the EDF. It is very widely deployed because it is reliable and easy to handle, and is used as a coaxial machine gun, door gun, or simply as a support firearm.

ThingDef.label: E2HMG Turret
ThingDef.description: It is a heavy machine gun operated by the EDF. It is very widely deployed because it is reliable and easy to handle, and is used as a coaxial machine gun, door gun, or simply as a support firearm.

ThingDef.label: EDF-FK200
ThingDef.description: Medium caliber Gatling gun in operation at EDF. It has a high rate of fire and suppression capability and is mainly used as a door gun or vehicle-mounted machine gun.

ThingDef.label: FK200 Turret
ThingDef.description: Medium caliber Gatling gun in operation at EDF. It has a high rate of fire and suppression capability and is mainly used as a door gun or vehicle-mounted machine gun.

ThingDef.label: EDF-A1Minigun
ThingDef.description: A large, multi-barreled machine gun. It can project an overwhelming barrage and is mounted on EDF close air support gunships such as the “Whale” and the “DE-202”.

ThingDef.label: A1Minigun Turret
ThingDef.description: Minigun turret with automatic sighting device.

ThingDef.label: EDF-MissileLauncher
ThingDef.description: A medium-sized missile launcher operated by EDF. It is used as a turret as it is, and is also mounted as a secondary weapon for large walking weapons.

ThingDef.label: Missile Turret
ThingDef.description: Missile turret with automatic sighting device.

ThingDef.label: EDF-Buster Cannon
ThingDef.description: A large, rapid-firing cannon operated by EDF. It is mounted as the main armament of large walking weapons.

ThingDef.label: Buster Cannon Turret
ThingDef.description: AutoCannon turret with automatic sighting device.

ThingDef.label: EDF MLRS
ThingDef.description: It is a multiple rocket launcher operated by EDF. It is basically designed to be mounted on a vehicle, but can also be set on a fixed launcher. It is deployed in large numbers as a fire support factor.

ThingDef.label: EDF MLRS
ThingDef.description: Large container unit loaded with 20 rockets.

ThingDef.label: AH-Cruise Missile
ThingDef.description: Medium cruise missiles in operation in the EDF. It has a moderate power and blast range, and is capable of cleaving a group of enemies. It is deployed in large numbers as heavy fire support personnel.

ThingDef.label: AH-Cruise Missile
ThingDef.description: Large container unit loaded with 4 Cruise Missile.

ThingDef.label: NX-Large Cruise Missile
ThingDef.description: Medium cruise missiles in operation in the EDF. It has a moderate power and blast range, and is capable of cleaving a group of enemies. It is deployed in large numbers as heavy fire support personnel.

ThingDef.label: NX-Large Cruise Missile
ThingDef.description: Large container unit loaded with 1 Large Cruise Missile.

ThingDef.label: Tempest Missile Silo
ThingDef.description: A large missile operated by EDF. With strategic power and a vast blast range, it is capable of destroying enemies in a wide area. If properly operated, it can drastically change the course of the war.

ThingDef.label: Tempest Missile Silo
ThingDef.description: A missile silo loaded with a large "Tempest" missile.

ThingDef.label: Tempest Missile Silo (Small)
ThingDef.description: A large missile operated by EDF. With strategic power and a vast blast range, it is capable of destroying enemies in a wide area. If properly operated, it can drastically change the course of the war.

ThingDef.label: EDF Rail cannon
ThingDef.description: An orbital interceptor weapon developed by the EDF with the full power of the EDF. A decisive battle weapon with ridiculous penetrating power and outrageous destructive force, it was intended to destroy alien mother ships outside the atmosphere. It is difficult to use because it can only fire directly and takes time to recharge, but its power more than makes up for these shortcomings.

ThingDef.label: Rail cannon
ThingDef.description: Large rail cannon for orbital interception.

ThingDef.label: Rail Main cannon
ThingDef.description: The rail cannon for orbital interceptors is reduced to a double-barreled battleship gun. Several are mounted as the main guns of the Decisive Fortress X4, a mobile weapon owned by the EDF. There are records that it has destroyed a number of invaders' walking fortresses, but the details are not clear.

ThingDef.label: Rail Main cannon
ThingDef.description: Huge rail cannon with double barrels.
